A Cybot '''G7 powerbus cable''' was a [[powerbus cable]] made by the [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] company for use in their [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Zippa]] spotted one in [[I-5YQ]].<ref name="Shadow Hunter" /> When I-5YQ arrived at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|RMSU]]-[[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chief Surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] spotted that his powerbus cables were not a standard model.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
